name: Super Dope Prepackaged Flower | Plum Popperz
description:
A Runtz cut crossed with Skittlez, the flavor most closely resembles a milky, creamy, sweet candy profile. It is regarded as the heaviest of the Popperz family in terms of potency and pressure, and effects.

This strain features a sweet and fairly typical Gelato flavor, with grape/gas/cream/ stonefruit/black plum scents dominating. The flavor is a nice sweet gassy grape + cherry limeade with light rubbery chemical smoke behind.
